knip.ts: // Workflow-invoked scripts are declared in `entry` above; the plugin would
// re-claim them as dev-only entries and hide their imports from --production.
scripts/build-runtime.ts: // Bun 1.4.0 intermittently drops the tsconfig `@/*` mapping inside `bun test` (f9671a17).
// Node caches bytecode only for modules compiled after `enableCompileCache` runs, so the module
// that calls it cannot be the bundle.
scripts/gui-assets.ts: // `args.path` is native, so the separator is a backslash on Windows.
src/core/io/safe-read.ts: // Canonicalize through the parent: a directory has one path, while macOS reports a
// hard-linked file by whichever of its names was looked up last.
src/core/shell/heredoc.ts: // A carriage return is an ordinary delimiter character in a shell, so `<<EOF\r\n` declares
// `EOF\r` and only an `EOF\r` line can end the body.
src/gate/analyzer/git/rules.ts: // Refnames cannot contain glob characters, so a glob operand is always a pathspec.
src/gate/analyzer/git/temp-root-relaxati:
/**
 * git accepts a unique trailing path component of any registered worktree as `<worktree>`, and
 * removes the registered worktree a symlinked operand resolves to.
 */
src/gate/analyzer/xargs.ts: // A case arm's `)` also opens a command word, but a substitution's `)` does not.
src/gate/secret/secret-protection.ts: // `-am` is `-a -m`; only letters that take no value may precede the `m`.
// `-files0-from FILE` reads FILE, which may sit before the start points.
src/hosts/hook/pre-tool-use.ts: // Only a host that prompts on `ask` may use it; Codex rejects it and runs the tool.
src/hosts/opencode/v2.ts: // The tool event does not expose the resolved executable.
tests/core/io/safe-read.test.ts: // macOS resolves a file's canonical path from the vnode's last-looked-up name, so while
// another process touches a hard link the same file reports either of its paths.
tests/helpers/fake-bin.ts:
/**
 * @internal Called from the run-wide afterAll in tests/setup.ts: bun evaluates this module once per
 * process, so a module-scope afterAll would fire after the first file that imported it and delete
 * the stub every later file links to.
 */
